<details>
The PKGBUILD file defines a standard build and packaging process for the cbsg (Corporate Bullshit Generator) package. The source is fetched from the official GitHub repository (https://github.com/zertovitch/cbsg), which matches the declared upstream URL. The source integrity is verified using a fixed SHA-256 checksum, indicating that the content is pinned to a specific version (the master branch tarball at the time of packaging), and no checksum is set to 'SKIP', so verification is enforced.

The build process uses `gprbuild`, which is expected for an Ada project, and links with standard hardening flags (`-z,relro,-z,now`). The package() function installs only two files: the compiled binary and the readme.md documentation, both from the expected source directory, into standard system paths. There are no suspicious commands such as `curl`, `wget`, `eval`, or `base64` decoding, nor any network operations during build or install. The operations are limited to compiling and installing the declared upstream project with no evidence of code injection, data exfiltration, or execution of external scripts.

All dependencies (gcc-ada, gprbuild) are legitimate build tools for Ada, and runtime dependencies are minimal (glibc). The package follows standard AUR packaging practices and shows no signs of malicious behavior.
</details>
